1.e4 c5 2.c4 d6 3.Nc3 Nc6 4.g3.strategy: Prepares the kingside fianchetto, so that the bishop covers the long diagonal and the king gets a safe home. White prefers a compact structure and a long manoeuvring game to a sharp fight in the centre.

1.e4 c5 2.c4 d6 3.Nc3 Nc6 4.g3 h5.strategy: An aggressive rim-pawn move aimed at ...h4, which would attack the g3 pawn and spoil White's kingside set-up. It costs a tempo and loosens Black's own kingside, so it is playable and surprising rather than a way to gain anything.
1.e4 c5 2.c4 d6 3.Nc3 Nc6 4.g3 h5.name: Sicilian Defence: Gloria Variation
